question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_year_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.constructor_id,
        r.year,
        SUM(cr.points) as constructor_points,
        MAX(r2.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN results r2 ON cr.race_id = r2.race_id AND r2.constructor_id = cr.constructor_id
    GROUP BY cr.constructor_id, r.year
)
SELECT 
    c.name as constructor_name,
    c.constructor_id,
    cys.year,
    cys.constructor_points,
    cys.best_driver_points,
    (cys.constructor_points + cys.best_driver_points) as combined_points
FROM constructor_year_stats cys
JOIN constructors c ON cys.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (cys.constructor_points + cys.best_driver_points) DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
